facts.claim: 亚当斯警探换上了灰西裤白衬衫，在庭院等我，迪尔德丽的遗体已被移走。
facts.quote: She had changed into gray slacks and a loose, white dress shirt

facts.claim: 她开门见山说自己有个提议：让我做她的非正式助手。
她自称三十八岁、女儿卡罗琳十六岁、正怀第四胎。
facts.quote: I’m thirty-eight. Caroline is my first. I was twenty-two when I had her.

facts.claim: 她强调多数案子在头四十八小时内破获，并说自己无下属可用。
facts.quote: the majority of cases are solved in the first forty-eight hours

facts.claim: 她要我说服卡拉威太太，让我尽可能全程旁观此案。
facts.quote: for you to witness as much of the case firsthand as you can

facts.claim: 她声明只在乎真相，谁做的、做过什么都不影响追责。
facts.quote: It doesn’t matter who she was. Or what she did.

facts.claim: 我答应下来，她笑着宣布开工——这是我头一次被官方邀请参与案件。
facts.quote: never before had anyone in an official capacity invited me onto a case

relations.rel: 母女；卡罗琳十六岁，是母亲的第一个孩子
relations.quote: I’m thirty-eight. Caroline is my first. I was twenty-two when I had her.

relations.rel: 凶案侦查负责人与死者
relations.quote: Deirdre Gregory’s body had been taken away already

relations.rel: 侦查者与可能的嫌疑对象，她表示不会徇私
relations.quote: if Genevieve herself were implicated in the death of Deirdre Gregory

relations.rel: 旧怨：此地人都知道吉纳维芙曾受过的苦
relations.quote: Everyone who lived here knew what Genevieve Caraway had suffered.

relations.rel: 上级与下属；她已派一名副手去应付媒体车
relations.quote: I’ve already had to dedicate one of my deputies to wrangle the press vans

numbers.claim: 多数案件在这段黄金时间内破获
numbers.quote: the majority of cases are solved in the first forty-eight hours
I’m thirty-eight. Caroline is my first.

numbers.claim: 她生第一个孩子时的年龄
numbers.quote: I was twenty-two when I had her.
At the moment I have three.

numbers.claim: 她怀孕已进入第二孕期
numbers.quote: “Second trimester, but it’ll be at least a week or two before anyone notices

numbers.claim: 卡罗琳周六芭蕾课每次三小时
numbers.quote: that lasts three hours on Saturdays

numbers.claim: 叙述者此前经历过两起凶杀调查
numbers.quote: I had been through two murder investigations by this point.

numbers.claim: 迪尔德丽是她亲眼所见的第七具尸体
numbers.quote: Deirdre Gregory’s corpse was the seventh dead body I’d seen with my eyes.

numbers.claim: 她打趣说自己话多顶两个人加三分之一
numbers.quote: Make that two and a third.

numbers.claim: 她抽一名副手去驱赶媒体车
numbers.quote: I’ve already had to dedicate one of my deputies to wrangle the press vans

numbers.claim: 当时气温已达华氏八十多度
numbers.quote: The air temperature was already in the mid-eighties

numbers.claim: 还要一两周别人才看得出她怀孕
numbers.quote: it’ll be at least a week or two before anyone notices

turning_point: 亚当斯警探主动招揽叙述者做她不成文的助手：原本偷偷进行的平行调查，一夜之间变成官方默许、可全程旁观的参与，代价是她要盯住吉纳维芙。
notes: 叙述者姓名本章未出现，故 relations 中不设其条目；‘Misty Copeland’‘Wicked Witch of the West’ 等典故未计入 numbers；‘a week or two’ 与 ‘Second trimester’ 同段落，分列两条。
